questions.learningObjective: Explain why magnetic force does no work on a charge
questions.stem: An amateur astronomer's log asks why the magnetic force on a moving charge does no work.

answer.exemplar: The magnetic force F = q v x B is always perpendicular to the velocity, so it changes the direction of motion but not the speed; hence it does no work and cannot change kinetic energy.

questions.explanation: Since F is perpendicular to v, F dot v = 0, so no work is done. A tempting error is to assume any force does work.
questions.hint: Work is F dot v; F is perpendicular to v.
